'''Airbases''' were military facilities used to construct and house [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]], and [[air transport]]s. They were utilized by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces|Naboo military]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. At least one airbase was located near the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], along with an [[Fortress/Legends|Imperial fortress]] and a [[War Center|war center]].
